title: Build your feature selection locally
description: Build a canonical openSynth and USB Recorder selection with your local tools and inspect its matching firmware bytes.
introduction: Choose openSynth, USB Recorder and their shortcuts in the picker, then build that exact configuration with the local helper.
selectionNote: Import the exported configuration or use the choices saved in this browser. Change features and shortcuts in the picker.
helperNote: Start the source-only helper on your computer with your official v5.52 firmware and matching installed tools. Paste the connection supplied by that helper. Firmware and compiler inputs stay on your computer.
buildNote: A build compiles the selected module and its separate P6S restoration. Keep failed attempts for review and use a new run name for another attempt.
receiptNote: The helper checks the authenticated source transaction. This page checks the canonical selection, configuration and complete candidate bytes before preparing a USB handoff.
heldNote: Selected expanded images remain held. This source recipe has no registered bench write authorization or public release qualification. A checked source build does not qualify recording into pads or global capture.
restorationNote: The byte-identical P6S restoration is a separate release. Its qualified USB path never authorizes a different selected candidate.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to connect the local helper and inspect a build. The build and delivery limits remain readable below.
footer: Local build inspection. Selected-image USB delivery remains held.
